item: local-ai (Android): on-device AI is the default for every AI feature. Gemini Nano runs through the ML Kit GenAI Prompt API / AICore. An optional downloadable Gemma 4 E2B (LiteRT-LM) is used instead of Nano when the user turns it on. Cloud providers move to an optional "Cloud assistants" section, off by default, with no automatic cloud fallback.
currentBehaviour:
Branch android-int-oct3 @ 90d32ca, read-only at /home/user/android-wt/base. Every LLM call goes through `AiHandler.generateContent` (data/ai/AiHandler.kt:178-310). It builds the layered system prompt (`AiSystemPromptEngine.buildPrompt`, data/ai/AiSystemPromptEngine.kt:88-255), checks a 30-min Room cache (:206-213), then walks `AiProviderSupport.buildProviderChain(primary)` (provider/AiProviderSupport.kt:81-101). The chain is the primary provider, then 11 cloud fallbacks, then ON_DEVICE. Each call has a 60 s timeout (AiHandler.kt:40, :122-139).

WHERE AI IS USED TODAY (call site → today's route → new route):
1. AI playlist sheet (Daily Mix sparkle). DailyMixScreen.kt:144-157 and :274 (not gated on any AI check) → PlayerViewModel.generateAiPlaylist:2814 → AiStateHolder.generateAiPlaylist (AiStateHolder.kt:119-220; candidate pool of 120 at :149-153) → AiPlaylistGenerator.generate (AiPlaylistGenerator.kt:24-107) → AiHandler(PLAYLIST). NEW: the on-device playlist curator (plan → fill → order).
2. AI Playlist Lab (`CreateAiPlaylistDialog`, PlaylistCreationDialogs.kt:300-415). Reached from LibraryScreen.kt:1700-1733 and :1756-1775. It asks for 5-150 songs (:405-406) and builds its request text at :1078-1140. Same path as 1, with saveAsPlaylist=true. NEW: curator with the long-playlist mode (the model picks attributes, the app fills, the model orders ~40).
3. "Generate with AI" from the create-playlist dialog in PlaylistBottomSheet.kt:213-219. It only sets showAiPlaylistSheet, and AiPlaylistSheet is rendered only in DailyMixScreen.kt:146, so outside Daily Mix nothing appears (latent bug, noted). NEW: same as 1.
4. Daily Mix refine. DailyMixMenu → AiStateHolder.regenerateDailyMixWithPrompt (:226-285, type DAILY_MIX, min max(60%,10), max max(size,20)). NEW: curator, seeded with the current mix.
5. Taizo chat. TaisChatViewModel.sendPrompt (TaisChatViewModel.kt:83-107) → TaisDjEngine.respond (TaisDjEngine.kt:45-63). Play/queue/find requests go through the deterministic TaisIntentParser/TaisMediaRouter (no LLM) plus an AI intro line with a 1.2 s budget (:71-86). Other messages get a TAIZO_CHAT answer with a 25 s budget (:53). Every message is a fresh single-turn call with no memory and no library grounding. NEW: on-device chat with memory and a library lookup. The intro goes async.
6. Home greeting headline and expanded insight. PlayerViewModel.kt:1881 and :2747 → HomeGreetingStateHolder.refresh (:115-166) and expandInsight (:68-107), type GREETING. NEW: on-device (tiny prompts).
7. Lyrics "Translate via AI". LyricsMoreBottomSheet.kt:233 → FullPlayerContent.kt:1100 → PlayerViewModel.translateLyricsViaAi:3259-3265 → LyricsStateHolder.translateLyricsViaAi (:405-461) → AiStateHolder.translateLyrics (:287-320). The whole LRC goes into one GENERAL prompt, and the reply must echo every line plus its translation. NEW: on-device, chunked line-by-line, with timestamps re-attached by the app.
8. Dead code, no callers: GeminiModelService.performAiTask (GeminiModelService.kt:108-132) → AiWorkerManager.enqueueAiTask/AiWorker (needs network, background); PlaylistViewModel.generateAiPlaylist (PlaylistViewModel.kt:981-1024); prompt types METADATA, TAGGING, MOOD_ANALYSIS and PERSONA have no live callers.
9. Cloud-only settings plumbing: model listing (SettingsViewModel.fetchAvailableModels:1348+, GeminiModelService.fetchAvailableModels:33-46).
10. Not LLMs, already local, unchanged: TAIS stems/alignment (LiteRT/ONNX); AiDailyMixWorker, which despite its name is a ranker (AiDailyMixWorker.kt:18-21); TaisIntentParser (keyword rules).

HOW THE PROVIDER IS CHOSEN TODAY:
- The default is GEMINI in three places: AiPreferencesRepository.kt:139-140 (`?: "GEMINI"`), AiProvider.fromString's fallback (AiProvider.kt:29-31) and SettingsViewModel.aiProvider's initial value (SettingsViewModel.kt:235-236). The picker labels Gemini "(Free)" (SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:1125-1136).
- ON_DEVICE today means a MediaPipe `.task` file the user imports by hand. There is no download: OnDeviceModelManager.kt:21-31 says Gemma is gated on Hugging Face. That is no longer true: litert-community/gemma-4-E2B-it-litert-lm is Apache-2.0 and `gated: False` (HF API, checked today). The file is copied into filesDir/on_device_models (:37), which Android Auto Backup includes.

PROVEN BUGS ON THE CURRENT ON-DEVICE PATH:
(a) Engine leak and reload on every call. AiHandler.kt:109-113 calls `clientFactory.createOnDeviceClient(modelPath)` on every request (AiClientFactory.kt:17 returns a new OnDeviceAiClient each time). The engine cache in OnDeviceAiClient.kt:36-49 is per instance, and `close()` (:90-93) is never called. So each call loads the whole model again and leaks the previous native LlmInference.
(b) "No Internet Connection" misreport. ON_DEVICE.displayName is "On-Device (Offline)" (AiProvider.kt:26). wrapThrowable prefixes messages with it (AiProviderSupport.kt:143-156, AiHandler.kt:283). Then AiPlaylistGenerator.buildDetailedErrorMessage matches "offline" (AiPlaylistGenerator.kt:126-132), and AiStateHolder.resolveAiErrorMessage matches "offline" or "connect" (AiStateHolder.kt:355-362). Result: every on-device failure on the playlist and Daily Mix paths reads "No Internet Connection". LyricsStateHolder.kt:452-455 also turns any message containing "key" or "config" into the API-key error.
(c) On-device users are locked out of the AI entry points. PlayerViewModel.hasActiveAiProviderApiKey (PlayerViewModel.kt:523-568) returns `else -> false` for "ON_DEVICE", which disables Library "With AI" (LibraryScreen.kt:1707-1716, :1757) and PlaylistBottomSheet (:215). HomeGreetingStateHolder.refresh returns early on a blank key even for ON_DEVICE (:142-144). Only expandInsight checks requiresApiKey (:82-87).
(d) No real cloud-off switch. With the default GEMINI and no key, the chain still tries Ollama with a blank URL and then ON_DEVICE (AiHandler.kt:219-233). In the other direction, choosing ON_DEVICE still falls back to every cloud provider that has a key.
(e) Taizo overlapping sends. Send is never disabled while a reply is in flight (TaisChatSheet.kt:193-201), and the reply replaces `messages.dropLast(1)` (TaisChatViewModel.kt:101-104). With two quick sends, the first reply deletes the second "Thinking" bubble and the first "Thinking" stays forever.

WHY TODAY'S PROMPTS DON'T FIT ON-DEVICE (measured from the source, token counts estimated at ~4 chars per token):
- System prompts: playlist ≈ 2,020 chars (persona 205 + layer 1,043 + few-shot 281 + constraints 449) ≈ 500-580 tokens; Taizo ≈ 1,320 chars; greeting ≈ 1,515 chars. ML Kit recommends system instructions under 150 words.
- Playlist user prompt: digest up to 4,000 chars in safe mode or 32,000 in full (UserProfileDigestGenerator.kt:18-24), plus a JSON pool of 40 songs, or 80 with "Save on usage" off (AiPlaylistGenerator.kt:47-69), at ~95 chars per song with ids such as "-3000000123456".
- That is roughly 2,600-2,900 input tokens in safe mode and over 10k with Save-on-usage off. Gemini Nano via ML Kit requires input "under 4000 tokens".
- The output must copy 14-char ids exactly. A 150-song Lab request is ~1k output tokens, and only the pool and digest ids are reachable anyway.
- Translation output is twice the input, and CJK/Vietnamese lyrics are ~1 token per character.

PLATFORM FACTS (researched today):
- ML Kit GenAI Prompt API: `com.google.mlkit:genai-prompt:1.0.0-beta4` (latest on Google Maven), minSdk 26. Its manifest adds the BIND_SERVICE permission and a <queries> entry for com.google.android.aicore.
- Pixel 10 / 10 Pro are listed for the Prompt API with nano-v3 (developers.google.com/ml-kit/genai). Gemini Nano runs in AICore (developer.android.com/ai/gemini-nano).
- API: `Generation.getClient()`. `suspend checkStatus(): @FeatureStatus Int` (UNAVAILABLE / DOWNLOADABLE / DOWNLOADING / AVAILABLE). `download(): Flow<DownloadStatus>`. `suspend generateContent(GenerateContentRequest)`. `generateContentRequest(SystemInstruction, TextPart) { temperature; topK; seed; maxOutputTokens }`. `suspend countTokens(request).totalTokens`. `suspend warmup()`. `close()`. Verified with javap on the AAR.
- Foreground only: BACKGROUND_USE_BLOCKED(30). Per-app quotas: BUSY(9) with `GenAiException.getRetryDelay()`, PER_APP_BATTERY_USE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED(27). Other codes: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE(12), NOT_AVAILABLE(8), AICORE_INCOMPATIBLE(-101), NEEDS_SYSTEM_UPDATE(604), RESPONSE/REQUEST_PROCESSING_ERROR(11/4).
- Devices with unlocked bootloaders are unsupported.
- MediaPipe LLM Inference is "in maintenance-only mode" and recommends LiteRT-LM.
- LiteRT-LM: `com.google.ai.edge.litertlm:litertlm-android:0.18.0` (needs Kotlin 2.4.0 and coroutines 1.11.0, the same as this repo). It ships arm64-v8a and x86_64 .so files only, with no armeabi-v7a.
- LiteRT-LM API: `Engine(EngineConfig(modelPath, backend, …, maxNumTokens, …, cacheDir))`, `initialize()`, `createConversation(ConversationConfig(systemInstruction, initialMessages, tools, samplerConfig, …, maxOutputToken, …, enableResponseFormat))`, `sendMessage(…, responseFormat = ResponseFormat.regex/json)`. Verified with javap.
- Gemma 4 E2B .litertlm: Apache-2.0, ungated, 2,588,147,712 bytes, sha256 181938105e0eefd105961417e8da75903eacda102c4fce9ce90f50b97139a63c, revision b3ca0d2f076785a8f4b2219ddbd2bdb99954eae1, ~0.7-0.8 GB RAM on GPU. The anonymous resolve URL answers 302 to the HF CDN.
alreadyOnAndroid:
Android already has the parts below. It lacks a working on-device default, availability gating that includes on-device, a context budget, a cloud-off switch, and a download.
- An ON_DEVICE provider: MediaPipe tasks-genai 0.10.27 (libs.versions.toml:7, app/build.gradle.kts:350-352), with the import, replace and remove UI at SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:1289-1380.
- The AI home greeting and expanded insight (HomeGreetingStateHolder, the feature iOS is porting).
- Taizo chat with a deterministic media router.
- The AI Playlist Lab (5-150 songs).
- A collapsed "Advanced" block (SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:1399-1573).
- Credentials hidden for ON_DEVICE (:1163-1164).
- Reusable pieces:
  - A verified-download pattern (OkHttp, .part file, SHA-256, percent progress) in AppUpdateManager.kt:222-278.
  - Foreground dataSync WorkManager infrastructure: AndroidManifest.xml:21 and :228-237; TaisForegroundNotifications.kt:41-73.
  - KSP 2.3.9.
  - A glass-aware `SettingsSubsection` (SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:3316-3330). New settings rows inherit glass mode automatically.
rootCause:
Several things combine:
- Cloud is the hard-coded default (AiPreferencesRepository.kt:140, AiProvider.kt:30, SettingsViewModel.kt:236).
- The only local path needs a hand-imported MediaPipe file that the app can't download (OnDeviceModelManager.kt:21-31). It reloads and leaks the model on every call (AiHandler.kt:109-113, AiClientFactory.kt:17).
- Every on-device error shows as "No Internet Connection" (AiProvider.kt:26 together with AiPlaylistGenerator.kt:126-132 and AiStateHolder.kt:355-362).
- The UI treats ON_DEVICE as "not configured" (PlayerViewModel.kt:549-561, HomeGreetingStateHolder.kt:142-144).
- The prompts were written for cloud context sizes, with a ~2k-char system layer, a 4k-32k-char digest and 40-80 JSON songs with raw ids. They don't fit a 4,000-token on-device input.
- There is no Gemini Nano (AICore) integration at all.

recommendedPlan.change:
Dependencies:
- libs.versions.toml: add `mlkitGenaiPrompt = "1.0.0-beta4"` → `mlkit-genai-prompt = { group = "com.google.mlkit", name = "genai-prompt", version.ref = "mlkitGenaiPrompt" }`.
- Add `litertlm = "0.18.0"` → `litertlm-android = { group = "com.google.ai.edge.litertlm", name = "litertlm-android", version.ref = "litertlm" }`. Pin it; don't use `latest.release`.
- Remove `mediapipeTasksGenai` (:7, :134). It is maintenance-only and replaced by LiteRT-LM. No .so name clash with litert 2.2.0 (checked the AARs: libLiteRt*.so vs liblitertlm_jni.so).
- build.gradle.kts: replace `implementation(libs.mediapipe.tasks.genai)` (:350-352) with `implementation(libs.mlkit.genai.prompt)` and `implementation(libs.litertlm.android)`.
- Optionally drop the unused `implementation(libs.generativeai)` (:356). Nothing imports com.google.ai.client; GeminiAiClient is plain REST.

ProGuard: replace the MediaPipe GenAI block (proguard-rules.pro:260-284) with `-keep class com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.** { *; }`. LiteRT-LM is a JNI bridge with reflection-based @Tool and ships no consumer rules. genai-prompt ships its own proguard.txt.

Manifest, inside <application>, for the LiteRT-LM GPU backend (litert-lm Kotlin docs):
- `<uses-native-library android:name="libOpenCL.so" android:required="false"/>`
- `<uses-native-library android:name="libvndksupport.so" android:required="false"/>`

No new permission: INTERNET and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC already exist (:5, :21).

Errors:
- `enum class OnDeviceFailure { NOT_SUPPORTED, NEEDS_UPDATE, PREPARING, TOO_LONG, BLOCKED, BUSY, DAILY_LIMIT, NEEDS_FOREGROUND, MODEL_MISSING, MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, OTHER }`.
- `class OnDeviceAiException(val failure: OnDeviceFailure, val retryAfterMs: Long? = null, cause: Throwable? = null) : Exception(failure.name, cause)`.
- Pure `object OnDeviceErrorMapper`:
  - `fromGenAi(e: GenAiException)` switches on `e.errorCode`: NOT_AVAILABLE/AICORE_INCOMPATIBLE→NOT_SUPPORTED, NEEDS_SYSTEM_UPDATE→NEEDS_UPDATE, REQUEST_TOO_LARGE→TOO_LONG, REQUEST_/RESPONSE_PROCESSING_ERROR/RESPONSE_GENERATION_ERROR→BLOCKED, BUSY→BUSY (retryAfter = `e.retryDelay?.toMillis()`), PER_APP_BATTERY_USE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED→DAILY_LIMIT, BACKGROUND_USE_BLOCKED→NEEDS_FOREGROUND, NOT_ENOUGH_DISK_SPACE→PREPARING, else OTHER.
  - `fromLiteRt(t)`: LiteRtLmJniException / UnsatisfiedLinkError / OOM → MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.
- One string resource per failure, e.g. "On-device AI is busy. Try again in a few seconds." / "Keep PixlAudio open while AI is working."
- These messages must never contain the words network, connect, offline, wifi, timeout, key or config. AiPlaylistGenerator.kt:121-158, AiStateHolder.kt:335-412 and LyricsStateHolder.kt:452-455 match on those.

Wraps ML Kit:
- A lazy `Generation.getClient()`, created off the main thread.
- `status: StateFlow<NanoStatus>` (Ready, NeedsDownload, Downloading(bytes), Unavailable(reason)), filled by `refresh()` = `checkStatus()`.
- `prepare()` collects `download()`: DownloadStarted, DownloadProgress.totalBytesDownloaded, DownloadCompleted, DownloadFailed.
- `prewarm()` = `warmup()`.
- `countTokens(sys, prompt) = model.countTokens(req).totalTokens`.
- `generate(sys, prompt, temperature, topK, maxOut, seed)`:
  - `model.generateContent(generateContentRequest(SystemInstruction(sys), TextPart(prompt)) { this.temperature = …; this.topK = …; maxOutputTokens = …; seed = … })`, then `candidates.firstOrNull()?.text`.
  - System instructions need nano-v3+. On NOT_SUPPORTED, retry once with the instruction folded into the TextPart.
- Serialize with a Mutex to avoid BUSY.
- Map GenAiException through OnDeviceErrorMapper.
- Never call from a Worker: inference is foreground-only.
- Leave thinking, prefix caching (experimental) and structured output (alpha, needs genai-schema-compiler) out of v1.

Catalog constant:
- Gemma 4 E2B-it: `https://huggingface.co/litert-community/gemma-4-E2B-it-litert-lm/resolve/b3ca0d2f076785a8f4b2219ddbd2bdb99954eae1/gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm`.
- size 2_588_147_712, sha256 181938105e0eefd105961417e8da75903eacda102c4fce9ce90f50b97139a63c, licence Apache-2.0.
- It cannot live in the project's own GitHub release: assets must be under 2 GiB.

Manager (@Singleton):
- Store under `noBackupFilesDir/llm/`, not filesDir, so Auto Backup never tries to copy 2.6 GB.
- `state: StateFlow<DownloadedModelState>` (NotDownloaded / Queued / Downloading(bytes,total) / Verifying / Ready(sizeBytes) / Failed(msg)), observed from `WorkManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWorkFlow("llm_download")`.
- `download(allowMetered)`: check free space with StatFs (size + 10%).
- `cancel()`.
- `delete()`: also releases the engine and turns the toggle off.
- `legacyImportedModel()`: reports filesDir/on_device_models/model.task so Settings can offer to remove it.

Worker:
- CoroutineWorker with `setForeground(...)` dataSync (same pattern as TaisForegroundNotifications.kt:41-73, its own channel and title "Downloading AI model").
- Constraints: UNMETERED unless the user chose otherwise, plus battery not low.
- Download as in AppUpdateManager.kt:222-278, with a new OkHttpClient from `okHttpClient.newBuilder()` and a 60 s read timeout. Add HTTP Range resume of the `.part` file: if the server answers 200 instead of 206, restart from 0.
- SHA-256 over the whole file after completion, then rename. On a mismatch, delete.
- `setProgress(workDataOf(bytes,total))` at most once per percent.
- Retry with exponential backoff.

One @Singleton engine, which fixes the per-call reload and leak at AiHandler.kt:109-113.

Loading:
- Lazy `Engine(EngineConfig(modelPath = path, backend = Backend.GPU(), maxNumTokens = 4096, cacheDir = context.cacheDir.path)).initialize()` on Dispatchers.Default.
- On failure, retry once with `Backend.CPU()`.
- Catch Throwable, including UnsatisfiedLinkError: there is no armeabi-v7a .so, so hide the feature when `Build.SUPPORTED_64_BIT_ABIS` is empty.

Generating:
- `generate(sys, prompt, temperature, topK, topP, maxOut, regex: String? = null)` uses a fresh `engine.createConversation(ConversationConfig(systemInstruction = Contents.of(sys), samplerConfig = SamplerConfig(topK, topP, temperature, seed), maxOutputToken = maxOut, enableResponseFormat = regex != null))` in `.use {}`.
- Call `sendMessage(prompt, responseFormat = regex?.let { ResponseFormat.regex(it) })`.
- Text = `contents.contents.filterIsInstance<Content.Text>().joinToString("") { it.text }`.
- Mutex-serialized.

Chat:
- `chatSession(sys)` returns a persistent Conversation that is reused, so its KV cache is the memory. Close and rebuild it with `initialMessages` holding the last 2 turns when the estimated tokens exceed ~3,000.

Memory:
- `release()` after 90 s idle, when the toggle turns off, on delete, and on `onTrimMemory(TRIM_MEMORY_UI_HIDDEN)`. The engine holds ~0.7-1.5 GB.

The NPU build (Tensor G5 file, 3.1 GB, `Backend.GOOGLE_TENSOR()`) is out of scope.

`LocalAi` facade (@Singleton) picks the engine:
- Gemma when `aiUseDownloadedModel` is on and the model is Ready; otherwise Nano.
- If Gemma fails to load (MODEL_LOAD_FAILED), use Nano for that request and log it (owner decision 4). Never fall back to the cloud.
- Exposes `generate(feature, sys, prompt, maxOut, regex?)`, `countTokens`, `prewarm(feature)` and `routeId` ("NANO" or "GEMMA4E2B") for cache keys.

`TokenBudget` (pure):
- Estimator: CJK, Thai, Hangul and Vietnamese-diacritic letters count 1 token each; other text = chars/3.2.
- On Nano, verify with countTokens.
- Shared limits: input ≤ 3,000 estimated tokens (Nano requires < 4,000), output ≤ 1,024 (Gemma engine maxNumTokens 4,096 total), instruction ≤ ~150 words.
- `shrinkToFit(items, render, limit)` helper.

`OnDevicePrompts`: compact per-feature instructions. They replace AiSystemPromptEngine layers on-device only, with no few-shot except one example for the greeting. The persona is clamped to 200 chars.

Per-feature budgets:
| Feature | Input (tokens) | Output (tokens) |
|---|---|---|
| Greeting | ~60 | 40 |
| Insight | ~80 | 160 |
| Taizo intro | ~60 | 32 |
| Taizo chat | instruction 150 + memory ≤ 700 + library facts ≤ 500 + question ≤ 300 | 320 |
| Playlist plan | instruction 150 + request ≤ 400 + vocabulary ≤ 450 | 160 |
| Order | ≤ 40 numbered lines ≈ 560 | 200 |
| Translation chunk | ≤ 900 | ≤ 1,024 |

AiProvider.kt:
- ON_DEVICE now means "system on-device AI" (Gemini Nano). Same key semantics as iOS, so cross-platform backups line up.
- Rename displayName to "On-device". It is only shown in usage logs and SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:1180, and must not contain "Offline".
- `fromString` falls back to ON_DEVICE, not GEMINI (:30). An unknown value must never route to the cloud.
- Leave buildProviderChain as is: AiProviderSupportTest pins it.

AiPreferencesRepository:
- `aiProvider` default "ON_DEVICE" (:139-140).
- New keys:
  - `ai_cloud_provider` (last chosen cloud provider, default "GEMINI"), so the Cloud switch can restore it;
  - `ai_use_downloaded_model` (Boolean, default false);
  - `ai_allow_metered_model_download` (Boolean, default false);
  - `ai_provider_migrated_v1` (Boolean).

SettingsViewModel: initial value "ON_DEVICE" (:236). Add:
- `setCloudAssistantEnabled(on)`: on → aiProvider = aiCloudProvider; off → "ON_DEVICE".
- `onCloudProviderChange(p)`: writes both keys, replacing the generic picker at :1297-1320 for cloud.
- `setUseDownloadedModel(on)`: on and not Ready → shows the download confirmation.
- `downloadModel()`, `cancelModelDownload()`, `deleteDownloadedModel()`, `prepareNano()`.
- Expose `nanoStatus` and `downloadedModelState`.
- Remove `importOnDeviceModel` (:475-482); keep a `removeLegacyImportedModel()`.

`AiProviderMigration.migrateIfNeeded()`:
- If `ai_provider_migrated_v1` is unset:
  - stored provider GEMINI (and, per owner decision 5, any provider that needs a key) with a blank key → set ai_provider to "ON_DEVICE";
  - OLLAMA/CUSTOM with a blank base URL → "ON_DEVICE";
  - providers with a key stay as the active cloud assistant, and their value is copied into ai_cloud_provider.
- Then set the flag. Use a single `dataStore.edit {}` so it is atomic.
- Run it from the startup scope in PixelPlayApplication.onCreate (:142-152), via a dagger.Lazy like the others.
- Also run it after a successful restore at BackupManager.restore (:169-172, `if (result is RestoreResult.Success)`). AI preferences live in the shared "settings" DataStore (UserPreferencesRepository.kt:35). GlobalSettingsModuleHandler clears and re-imports every key (:35-47), so an old backup brings back GEMINI without the flag, and the run after restore converts it once.
- Legacy MediaPipe file: leave it. Settings shows a "Remove old imported model (N MB)" row.

Routing in generateContent (:178-310):
- Resolve the provider. If ON_DEVICE → `localAi.generate(...)` with `OnDevicePrompts.instructionFor(type, persona)` and the type's maxOut. Ignore topP, topK, penalties and maxTokens from preferences; keep the user's Temperature if they changed it from 0.7 (:185-198).
- Throw OnDeviceAiException as is. Don't wrap it in AiProviderException.
- Skip the provider chain entirely: no cloud fallback.
- Cloud provider → the existing chain with `.filter { it != AiProvider.ON_DEVICE }` (:215).
- Remove the ON_DEVICE branch in generateWithRecovery (:109-113), which was the leak.
- Include `localAi.routeId` in the cache hash (:206) so Nano and Gemma answers aren't mixed.
- Record usage with the provider label "On-device (Nano)" or "On-device (Gemma 4)".

Add `suspend fun currentRoute(): AiRoute` (OnDevice(engine) | Cloud(provider)) for callers that need per-feature on-device paths.

AiPlaylistGenerator.generate (:24-107): when `aiHandler.currentRoute()` is OnDevice, delegate to `OnDevicePlaylistCurator.curate(userPrompt, allSongs, min, max, seedPool = candidateSongs, type)` and return its `Result<List<Song>>`. The cloud path is unchanged. Owner decision: plan → fill → order, for every on-device playlist request.

(1) PLAN:
- Library vocabulary: the top 25 genres and top 30 artists by plays and song count, from PlaybackStatsRepository.loadSummary and the song list. No ids.
- Ask for one JSON object: `{"genres":[≤4],"artists":[≤6],"moods":[≤3],"energy":1-5,"discovery":1-5,"eraFrom":yyyy|null,"eraTo":yyyy|null,"keywords":[≤4]}`. maxOut 160, temperature 0.2.
- Gemma: constrain with `ResponseFormat.json(schemaMap)`. Prove it on device; if not, fall back to regex or no format.
- Parse leniently with kotlinx Json { isLenient; ignoreUnknownKeys } after AiResponseCleaner.
- On parse failure, build the plan from `TaisIntentParser.parse(prompt)` genres and moods.
- Map plan genres and artists to library values case-insensitively.

(2) FILL (pure, unit-testable), scoring each song:
- genre match, artist match;
- mood → genre family table (reuse the TaisIntentParser mood words);
- energy → genre-family heuristic (Song has no energy or mood field);
- year within the era;
- discovery via DailyMixManager.getAllEngagementStats play counts (low discovery prefers played songs, high prefers unplayed);
- favourites boost;
- personalizedPicks rank as tiebreak.
- At most 3 songs per artist. Take max(min, min(max, 150)). Top up from the seed pool or DailyMixManager.generateDailyMix. Dedupe.
- "Avoid explicit" can't be honoured: there is no explicit flag.

(3) ORDER:
- Send the first ≤ 40 picks as `N. Title — Artist · genre`. Ask for a comma-separated order (Gemma: `ResponseFormat.regex("\\d{1,2}(,\\d{1,2}){0,39}")`).
- Parse, drop out-of-range numbers and duplicates, append the rest in fill order.

When the plan call fails with BLOCKED or TOO_LONG, use the deterministic plan from TaisIntentParser. Other failures surface as OnDeviceAiException.

Daily Mix refine passes the current mix as the seed pool.

Also clamp AiPlaylistSheet's free-text min and max (AiPlaylistSheet.kt:83-84, :437-439) to 5..50.

Errors:
- Move error resolution into a pure `AiErrorMessages.resolve(error, res)` (testable).
- First rule: `error.findCause<OnDeviceAiException>()` → its string resource. Before the API-key and network rows at :335-362.
- `apiKey` messages only for cloud routes.

risks: Foreground-only plus quotas. ML Kit returns BACKGROUND_USE_BLOCKED if PixlAudio isn't the top app, so a playlist that is still generating when he leaves the app fails. Rapid Taizo messages can hit BUSY, and PER_APP_BATTERY_USE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED is a daily cap. Messages must explain each case. There must be no on-device calls from WorkManager (AiWorker, AiDailyMixWorker).

API maturity: genai-prompt is 1.0.0-beta4. System instructions need nano-v3+. Structured output (alpha), prefix caching (experimental) and the undocumented `tools` builder field are deliberately not used. LiteRT-LM is 0.x: its `ResponseFormat.json/regex` (constrained decoding) and Gemma 4 tool calling must be proven on the device. The plan falls back to lenient text parsing either way.

Context budget: the token estimator is approximate for Gemma. Nano's countTokens is exact, but LiteRT-LM's Kotlin API has no token count (checked with javap). Vietnamese and CJK lyrics and chat use ~1 token per character, so translation chunks must shrink. A REQUEST_TOO_LARGE or LiteRT overflow should trigger one retry with half the chunk or pool.

Memory and thermals: Gemma 4 E2B on GPU takes ~0.7-0.8 GB of CPU RAM, and more on first load. Loading takes up to ~10 s. It competes with ExoPlayer, the ONNX wav2vec2 aligner (378 MB) and the TAIS stem GPU or NPU work. The engine must be released on idle and trim, and the TAIS Studio runner may need to be serialized with it.

Download: 2.59 GB from the HF CDN (302 redirect).
- Range resume support on the xet CDN is unverified, so the code must handle a 200 answer by restarting.
- Storage check needed.
- It must go in noBackupFilesDir, or Auto Backup tries to include it (backup_rules.xml excludes only the DataStore).
- GitHub's 2 GiB per-asset limit rules out mirroring it to the project's own release.
- Pin the HF revision, since the file was re-uploaded for speculative decoding (model card).

ABI: litertlm-android ships no armeabi-v7a .so. The project builds a v7a split (CLAUDE.md, enableAbiSplits). The downloaded-model switch must be hidden on 32-bit-only devices, and engine init must catch UnsatisfiedLinkError. Replacing MediaPipe (12.8 MB arm64 .so) with LiteRT-LM (22.2 MB) adds ~9 MB to the arm64 APK; genai-prompt adds ~1.4 MB of classes.

Quality: Nano is a small model. Free-form music trivia can be wrong, so ground answers with LibraryLookup and keep replies short. Song has no energy, mood or explicit metadata, so the plan → fill step relies on a heuristic genre table, and "avoid explicit" can't be honoured.
